data.one_liner: WidgetFactory extension to render IFRAME elements using the official WebView plugin.
data.what_it_does: Extends flutter_widget_from_html_core to render HTML IFRAME elements as native WebViews using the official webview_flutter plugin. It supports configurable settings such as JavaScript, user agents, debugging, and media playback.
use_when: You are using flutter_widget_from_html_core and need to render IFRAMEs as WebViews.
You need configurable WebView behaviors like custom user agents or media playback permissions inside HTML content.
avoid_when: You need a standalone full-screen webview browser rather than inline HTML rendering.
strengths: Seamless integration with flutter_widget_from_html_core via mixins.
Configurable getters for controlling WebView properties like debugging, gestures, and user agents.
weaknesses: Strictly tied to flutter_widget_from_html_core as a companion add-on.
Relies on native webview implementations which can add overhead.
data.setup_notes: Add both flutter_widget_from_html_core and fwfh_webview to pubspec.yaml, then create a custom WidgetFactory mixing in WebViewFactory.
